extDescription.message: Real-time speech-to-text with AI cleanup. Recognizes 11 languages. Add a Gemini API key to auto-polish your transcript.

noApiKey.message: ⚠️ Skipped AI cleanup — no API key. You can add one in ⚙️ Settings.

cleanErrDenied.message: ⚠️ This project cannot use the Gemini API (see ⚙️ Settings for details)

langChanged.message: 🌐 Language changed (applies from the next recording)

langNote.message: Choose the language you speak. Your speech is transcribed in that language, and the AI cleanup uses it too.

langNoteLearn.message: Using it to learn a language:

langNoteLearnBody.message: Keep the interface in your own language and switch only this setting. For example, set it to English to transcribe English practice.

linkGetKey.message: 🔗 Get an API key in Google Cloud Console

howToGetBody.message: Open Google Cloud Console → select or create a project → "Credentials" → "Create API key" → copy it into the field above → Save.

jpNoticeBody1.message: Free API keys issued through Google AI Studio (aistudio.google.com) may be rate-limited when accessed from Japan.

jpNoticeBody2.message: If that happens, set up a billing account in Google Cloud Console and issue the key there. Linking a billing account moves the project out of the free tier, so you are charged for what you use (typically well under a dollar a month for light use).

budgetNote.message: If you are worried about spending, you can set a budget alert in Google Cloud.

budgetLink.message: 🔗 How to set a budget alert

securityBody.message: Your API key is stored only inside your Chrome and is never sent to any external server. Please still keep the following in mind.

securityLi1.message: Do not share your API key with anyone

securityLi2.message: If it leaks, you can revoke it immediately in Google AI Studio

securityLi3.message: If you share this device with others, we recommend deleting the key after use

tier1Body.message: Real-time speech-to-text, copy, and clear. Works as a zero-setup memo tool.

tier2Body.message: Gemini cleans up your transcript automatically when you stop recording — removing fillers, adding punctuation, and tidying spoken language. You can review and copy it any time from the cleanup tab.

enterOrSaveFirst.message: Please enter or save an API key first

errDenied.message: This project is not allowed to access the Gemini API. Open the API key list in Google AI Studio and check the "Billing tier" column — if it says "Unavailable", no free tier has been assigned to the project. (Your API key itself is fine.)

errKeyInvalid.message: The API key is not valid. Copy the key again and paste it into the field above.
